meta.title: DSH Chat Source Tracer
meta.description: Select a sentence in a long conversation to see which earlier questions, conclusions, and external sources support it; keep decisions, assumptions, and excerpts in an exportable archive.

panel.title: Where this came from
panel.hint: Drag across a sentence in the chat · Esc to cancel
panel.unsupported: No supporting source found — the model may have added this itself.
panel.noRoute: The Host endpoint is not reachable. Reinstall or restart the plugin.
panel.claimMissing: That sentence was not found in the session log; analyzed from the selection alone.
